==cmsis-rtos api 中的原生任务创建函数==

pxtaskcode 表示指向任务函数的指针

![file-20260421201638273.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%9D%BF/ARM%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84/STM32F103C8T6/STM32F103C8T6FreeRTOS/assets/%E4%BB%BB%E5%8A%A1%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E7%9A%84%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA/file-20260421201638273.png)![file-20260421201638275.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%9D%BF/ARM%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84/STM32F103C8T6/STM32F103C8T6FreeRTOS/assets/%E4%BB%BB%E5%8A%A1%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E7%9A%84%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA/file-20260421201638275.png)

任务函数结构体，包括任务名称，任务堆栈大小，和任务优先级

pvparameters 是传给任务函数的形参

TCB_t 结构指针是任务控制块，该结构体包含了一个任务的所有信息

	![Pasted image 20250627154038.png](https://github.com/shuai-yemao/Deep-In-Embedded/raw/5fcab575fc20cf681f3e79e163337211097c898a/%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%9D%BF/ARM%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84/STM32F103C8T6/STM32F103C8T6FreeRTOS/assets/%E4%BB%BB%E5%8A%A1%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E7%9A%84%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA/Pasted%20image%2020250627154038.png)

	pxtopofstack是栈顶指针，指向任务的栈顶

	xstatelistItem是状态链表，阻塞表，挂起表，运行表等；

	xeventlistItem是事件链表

	pxstack为任务分配堆栈地址空间，可以用来检测堆栈是否溢出
